### Restore the full-bucket fallback when selection cleanup fails

In [run_enforced_tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d3baa05c9e685f7e8d8573a297760c7ca8dab4a6/tests/unit_tests/run_ci_test.sh#L337-L362), cleanup now runs outside the guarded selection chain. With `UNIT_TESTMON_MODE=enforce`, any nonzero `rm -rf` result exits the script under `set -e`, without running selection or the full bucket. The base implementation fell back to full execution for this failure, and the deleted [native-selection regression](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/e14be57fe1855cc61ef8af92e779239d0f5a5637/tests/test_utils/test_unit_testmon.py#L433-L510) explicitly covered it by making `rm` return 7.

**Correction:** Replace lines 350–351 in the runner with the following guarded cleanup, retaining the remaining selection chain and fallback body:

```diff
-        rm -rf -- "$UNIT_TESTMON_CACHE_DIR/.testmon-work"
-        if ! run_testmon_phase select prod \
+        if ! rm -rf -- "$UNIT_TESTMON_CACHE_DIR/.testmon-work" \
+            || ! run_testmon_phase select prod \
```

This restores the invariant that preparation or collection failures run the full bucket. It leaves the separate `preselected` validation branch unchanged and keeps selected-test failures outside the fallback guard.

**Proposed acceptance checks:** Restore the removed native orchestration regression. When cleanup returns 7, assert one full-bucket execution, no collection or selected-test execution, and success if the full bucket succeeds. Retain its collection, merge, and mandatory-mapping failure cases and its successful-path assertion that both phases execute for every repeat. Preserve the invalid-plan failure in [test_cpu_plan_execution](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d3baa05c9e685f7e8d8573a297760c7ca8dab4a6/tests/test_utils/test_unit_testmon.py#L616-L677), and retain [test_selected_test_failure_does_not_run_full_bucket](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d3baa05c9e685f7e8d8573a297760c7ca8dab4a6/tests/test_utils/test_unit_testmon.py#L381-L406)'s exit-1 and no-full-rerun assertions.

I inspected all changed files and their directly affected paths. The workflow child's written report was unavailable, so I completed its dispatch and coverage inspection directly. I didn't execute tests; verify the suggested patch before adopting it.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

+"""Select all unit-test buckets on one CPU runner and publish the GPU matrix."""

+import json
+import logging
+import os

+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path

+def _actions(operation: str, *args: str) -> None:
+    # The workflow supplies the small adapter for GitHub's Node-only SDKs.
+    subprocess.run(
+        [os.environ["TESTMON_NODE"], "-e", os.environ["TESTMON_ACTIONS"], operation, *args],
+        check=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _python(script: str, args: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    output = subprocess.check_output(
+        [sys.executable, f"tests/unit_tests/{script}", *args], text=True
+    )
+    logger.info(output.strip())
+    return dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in output.strip().splitlines())

+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Restore each baseline, run the existing selector, and upload its plan."""
+    if os.environ["TARGET_BRANCH"] != "main":
+        raise ValueError("Testmon selection requires main")
+    platform = os.environ["RECIPE_PLATFORM"]
+    generation = f"{os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']}-{os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']}"
+    temporary = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"])
+    cache_dir = Path("assets_dir/testmon")
+    plan = "assets_dir/testmon-plan/plan.json"
+    matrix = []
+    summary = [
+        "### Unit tests selection",
+        "",
+        "| Bucket | Mode | GPU required |",
+        "| --- | --- | --- |",
+    ]
+
+    # Restore sequentially: the path is part of the existing cache version.
+    for entry in json.loads(os.environ["BUCKETS"]):
+        bucket = entry["bucket"]
+        logger.info("Selecting %s", bucket)
+        identity = _python(
+            "testmon_cache.py",
+            [
+                "identity",
+                "--bucket",
+                bucket,
+                "--platform",
+                platform,
+                "--output",
+                str(temporary / "unit-testmon-identity.json"),
+            ],
+        )
+        if cache_dir.exists():
+            shutil.rmtree(cache_dir)
+        matched_key = ""
+        key_file = temporary / "unit-testmon-matched-key"
+        prefix = identity["cache_prefix"]
+        try:
+            _actions(
+                "restore", str(cache_dir), f"{prefix}lookup-{generation}", prefix, str(key_file)
+            )
+            matched_key = key_file.read_text()
+        except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
+            logger.warning("Testmon cache restore failed for %s", bucket)
+        result = _python(
+            "testmon_selector.py",
+            [
+                "select",
+                "--cache-dir",
+                str(cache_dir),
+                "--bucket",
+                bucket,
+                "--platform",
+                platform,
+                "--source-sha",
+                os.environ["SOURCE_SHA"],
+                "--matched-key",
+                matched_key,
+                "--pr-files-dir",
+                os.environ["PR_FILES_DIR"],
+                "--output",
+                plan,
+            ],
+        )
+        mode, has_tests = result["mode"], result["has_tests"]
+        if (
+            mode not in {"selected", "full"}
+            or has_tests not in {"true", "false"}
+            or (mode == "full" and has_tests != "true")
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid Testmon selection result for {bucket}")
+        artifact = ""
+        if mode == "selected":
+            bucket_hash = hashlib.sha256(bucket.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+            artifact = f"unit-test-plan-{platform}-{bucket_hash}-{generation}"
+            # Upload empty plans too: the coverage gate uses them as skip evidence.
+            _actions("upload", artifact, plan, "assets_dir/testmon-plan")
+        if has_tests == "true":
+            matrix.append(

+                    **entry,
+                    "mode": "preselected" if mode == "selected" else "full",
+                    "plan_artifact": artifact,
+                }
+            )
+        summary.append(f"| `{bucket}` | {mode} | {has_tests} |")
+
+    with Path(os.environ["GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"]).open("a") as stream:
+        stream.write("\n".join(summary) + "\n")
+    with Path(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"]).open("a") as stream:
+        stream.write(f"matrix={json.dumps(matrix, separators=(',', ':'))}\n")
+        stream.write(f"has_tests={str(bool(matrix)).lower()}\n")
+

+if __name__ == "__main__":

+    main()

### Restore the full-bucket fallback when selection cleanup fails

In [run_enforced_tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d3baa05c9e685f7e8d8573a297760c7ca8dab4a6/tests/unit_tests/run_ci_test.sh#L337-L362), cleanup now runs outside the guarded selection chain. With `UNIT_TESTMON_MODE=enforce`, any nonzero `rm -rf` result exits the script under `set -e`, without running selection or the full bucket. The base implementation fell back to full execution for this failure, and the deleted [native-selection regression](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/e14be57fe1855cc61ef8af92e779239d0f5a5637/tests/test_utils/test_unit_testmon.py#L433-L510) explicitly covered it by making `rm` return 7.

**Correction:** Replace lines 350–351 in the runner with the following guarded cleanup, retaining the remaining selection chain and fallback body:

```diff
-        rm -rf -- "$UNIT_TESTMON_CACHE_DIR/.testmon-work"
-        if ! run_testmon_phase select prod \
+        if ! rm -rf -- "$UNIT_TESTMON_CACHE_DIR/.testmon-work" \
+            || ! run_testmon_phase select prod \
```

This restores the invariant that preparation or collection failures run the full bucket. It leaves the separate `preselected` validation branch unchanged and keeps selected-test failures outside the fallback guard.

**Proposed acceptance checks:** Restore the removed native orchestration regression.
